description: Lists every site you own, newest first - site_key, name, preview_url and when that preview link expires, whether it is published and on which domain, and when it was created and last changed. Signed in (OAuth) it lists your account; with a draft_token it lists that draft. Read-only and free.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

name: list_sites
title: List your sites
